raw_segments.text: Imogen, away! I do condemn mine ears that have so long attended thee. If thou wert honorable,
thou wouldst have told this tale for virtue, not for such an end thou seekst thee, as base
as strange. Thou wrongs thee a gentleman who is as far from thy report as thou from honor,
and solicits here a lady that distains thee and the devil alike. What ho, Pisannio! The
king my father shall be made acquainted of thy assault. If he shall think it fit a saucy
stranger in his court to mart as in a Romish stew, and to expound his beastly mind to us,
he hath a court he little cares for, and a daughter who he not respects at all. What ho, Pisannio!
